title: To lower the age at which a minor may be tried as an adult for certain criminal offenses in the District of Columbia to 14 years of age.

claims.claim: Amends two sections of the District of Columbia Official Code.
claims.sourceSpan: Section 16-2307(a), District of Columbia Official Code, is amended
claims.note: Two amended sections: 16-2301 (subsec (a)) and 16-2307(a) (subsec (b)); both cited verbatim in source.

claims.claim: Lowers the age at which a minor may be treated as an adult in criminal proceedings for certain offenses.
claims.sourceSpan: To lower the age at which a minor may be tried as an adult for certain criminal offenses in the District of Columbia to 14 years of age.

claims.note: 'exclusion' matches subsec (a) heading (Excluded From Jurisdiction of Family Court); figures + direction verbatim.

claims.claim: In section 16-2307(a) the ages at which a minor may be transferred to a criminal proceeding drop from 'fifteen,' 'sixteen,' and 'eighteen' to 'fourteen' in paragraphs (1), (2), and (3) respectively.
